register_oot_forward: register an out-of-tree forward implementation for a specific op class and platform key
dispatch_forward: dispatch the correct forward method based on the current hardware platform
enter_torch_compile: enter torch compile mode and swap the forward method for the compiled variant
leave_torch_compile: exit torch compile mode and restore the original forward method
forward_native: implement a PyTorch-native forward pass that falls back when no hardware-specific method exists
